description.hr: Lupa je nezavisni dvojezični blog o tržištu dionica s fokusom na male tvrtke: što zaista rade, kako su povezane s velikim igračima i koliko vrijede — bioinženjering, kvantno računalstvo i duboka tehnologija.
description.en: Lupa is an independent bilingual research blog on equity markets, focused on small companies: what they actually do, how they connect to large incumbents, and what the market pays for them — bioengineering, quantum computing and deep tech.
